title: Notion Integration token: one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: one character of the alphanumeric run replaced with '!', outside every cited alphabet (including lore's [A-Za-z0-9_-]); the digit run and length are unchanged. Twin of "Notion Integration token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
